KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_RESEARCHADMIN: The abandoned administrative building for the Enelica corporation.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_TESTINGANNEX: A half-drowned testing center overlooking the red lakes.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_ELECTRICALSUBSTATION: A rocky basin full of old power generators.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_WATERTREATMENT: A concrete monolith of pipes, tubes, and old water treatment equipment.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_POWERGENERATIONCOMPLEX: A rusting relic of hydrogen infrastructure.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_OLDBATTLEGROUND: An old First Wave battleground where lopsided forts and wrecked ARC parts still remain.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_CONTROLTOWER: Located above the Admin building. An excellent vantage point for looking out over the battlegrounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_HYDRODOMES: A field scattered with glass domes that were once used for plant cultivation.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_MARANOPARK: The densely overgrown city park of Marano.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_GRANDIOSOAPARTMENT: The former residences of workers from the Alcantara Dam.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_RESEARCHBUILDING: An abandoned research building in central Marano. The labs are empty, dusty equipment still lined up as if someone might return at any moment.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_SPACETRAVEL: The satellite dishes of the old space travel building are frozen mid-tilt, still aimed at skies they no longer listen to.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_TOWNHALL: The seat of government in Marano, before the Collapse.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_PARKINGGARAGE: Car husks, stashed loot, and plenty of dark corners litter the Marano Parking Garage.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_CHURCHRUINS: This home for devout parishioners has been abandoned for years.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_GALLERIA: Even after 200 years of disuse, the dilapidated Galleria still holds items of value.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_HOSPITAL: This run-down hospital once served as the only source of medical aid in the greater Marano area.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_DEPARTUREBUILDING: The former Avantale security gate for passengers headed to the Launch Towers.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_ARRIVALBUILDING: The ransacked reception building for aspiring space travelers.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_ROCKETASSEMBLY: A graveyard of rocket parts that never made it to space.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_VEHICLEMAINTENANCE: The Spaceport’s many buses and cargo trucks used to come here for a tune-up.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_CONTROLTOWERB6: Shorter than the Launch Towers, but still a decent view of the grounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_ANCIENTFORT: Ruins of a fort from before the Collapse.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_ADORNEDWRECKAGE: A graveyard of wreckage that was already here before any Speranzans arrived.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_RAIDERREFUGE: Raiders are trying to make this outpost their own. The ARC are making that difficult.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_LOWERVILLAGE: A village from long before the sprawling astro-infrastructure took over the land.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_COMMSTOWER: An antenna that has been seemingly transformed by traveling pilgrims.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_ABANDONEDHOUSINGPROJ: This architectural project stands abandoned, unfinished and untouched.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_WAREHOUSECOMPLEX: Rumor has it that there's more than just rats running through this old Supracosta warehouse.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_CHECKPOINT: Piles and piles of abandoned vehicles sit outside the gates, forever waiting to be let in.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_ASSEMBLYWORKSHOP: Some experimental technology was being explored on these high-tech assembly lines.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_ROBOTICSANDBOXA: An old vehicle testing facility. It’s unclear what kind of terrain they were being created for.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_CAFETERIA: Few traces of humanity are left in this strangely empty cafeteria.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_SEEDVAULTINTERIO: An icy vault that looks like it was once meant to ensure the future of food cultivation.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_AUDITORIUM: A large, hard to access viewing area where private meetings were likely hosted.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_CULTURALARCHIVES: An underground storage unit of humanity’s premier works of art and literature.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_MEDICALWINGNORTH: It seems that advanced medical research was being conducted here, far beyond what Raiders have encountered in other old medical bays.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_CONTROLLEDACCESSZONE: Ivy and rusting ARC husks are all that’s seemingly left of this underground power station
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_HOTEL: A particularly lavish harbor resort, said to have hosted all of the Exodus' most distinguished supporters and financiers.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_LOGISTICS: Signage indicates that some of the Exodus' valuable goods once passed right through this complex.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_CONTAINERYARD: Just a glimpse of these sky-scraping containers makes one want to stack things very high.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_WAVEBREAKERCOMPOUN: Once the beating heart of all maritime operations, it allows for dilligent surveillance of the port in every direction.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_WRECKAGES: Ages of violent undercurrents and biting rust have taken a visible toll.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_HOTELBEACH: A secluded stretch of once-pristine beachfront.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_CHECKPOINT: With scales embedded into the road's surface, this must've been about as elegant as a checkpoint gets.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_RAILYARD: An Exodus-era railyard, seemingly designed to handle delicate, uncommonly shaped freight.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_LOADINGPLATFORM: These platforms allow for the handling of particularly delicate goods.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_VILLAGE: Isolated yet seemingly close-knit, most of the village of Almatera has been swallowed by an avalanche.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_SUPERMARKET: With surprisingly elaborate shelving, this supermarket must've provisioned locals and astronomers alike.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_CENTRALSTATION: Said to have once been a quaint local station, these tracks now seem to support high axle-load traffic.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_OBSERVATORY: A marvel of astronomical ingenuity, even to those unable to fathom its one-time readings.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_TELESCOPE: Perched atop a mountain summit, this marvel of astronomy puts all other antennas to shame.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_COLLECTOR: Stuck between snow and debris, this giant walker seems to attract ARC attention from far beyond the Rust Belt.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_FROZENRIVER: A long-frozen river that leaves prospective ice skaters dangerously exposed.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_OLDHAMLET: Standing tall amongst the snows, this lodge straddles the line between rustic and chique.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_OLDTOWN: Strolling across these narrow streets, you can almost picture the days before astronomical and fallen behemoths.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_CHURCH: A church in the centre of the Old Town, weathered by time.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_GASSTATION: A gasoline-stained refuge for the weary traveler.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_SUBSTATION: A substation built to provide reliable power in the harshest weather conditions.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_TUNNEL: A sturdy concrete tunnel that has mostly withstood the test of time, providing shelter and safe passage.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_RAILWAYCROSSING: Crossing these train tracks, one may picture hungry astronomers heading out for lunch.
KeysToEntries.ID_TOOLTIP_FROZENTRAIL_WEATHERSTATION: A versatile meteorological instrument, long retired.
